formats.what: Layered files with smart objects. Double-click the smart object, paste your design, save, and the mockup updates with realistic lighting and folds.
The master file. Every shape, colour and letter stays fully editable, so you can rename a logo, recolour it or pull it apart.
Lightweight vectors that stay razor sharp at any size. Drop them into websites, Figma, Canva or a Cricut and they just work.
The classic vector format for print shops, sign makers and embroidery. Send it as is and it prints crisp at any size.
Opens on any device. Vector PDFs keep their sharp edges, so they're perfect for client previews and sending straight to print.
High-resolution images with transparent backgrounds. No design app needed: post it, place it, or drop it into a slide.
